🇵🇰
Learn Trading in Pakistan

TradeHQ provides a free paper-trading environment for people in Pakistan who want to learn global market mechanics without opening a real-money brokerage account.

Educational simulation only — not financial advice.

QUICK ANSWER
Is TradeHQ suitable for Pakistan traders?

Yes. TradeHQ is a free educational trading simulator accessible from Pakistan with no required signup or payment. TradeHQ is a virtual practice tool, not a broker, and does not execute real trades. This page does not determine your legal eligibility or a provider’s regulatory status. Every account starts with $100,000 in virtual cash for an educational worksheet; access does not establish eligibility for a real account. Educational simulation only — not financial advice.

Published by TradeHQ. Site creator: Anuga Weerasinghe. Regulatory source check: 2026-10-18.

Linked regulator or registry information; no verification of individual eligibility, tax rates or remittance permission. No professional legal or financial review.

SECP — capital-market licensing
LOCAL REGULATOR
Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP)

Check current local rules and provider registration with the relevant official authority. This guide does not certify regulatory compliance.

LOCAL EXCHANGE

Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX)

Local currency: PKR

Why practise before you fund a real account

Paper trading lets users practise global-market mechanics without relying on a particular real-money funding or overseas-access route. Current access and exchange-control rules should be checked with official Pakistani sources.

How market access actually works in Pakistan

For real-money market access, check the SECP's current licensed-broker and intermediary information together with current provider requirements. For foreign-market access or outward remittances, verify the current rules with the relevant Pakistani authorities and financial institution. Simulated practice on TradeHQ requires no brokerage account or payment.

How much capital do you really need?

TradeHQ does not publish a real-money starting amount because broker requirements, charges and personal circumstances vary. Verify any current minimum or eligibility rule directly with a licensed provider if you ever consider a real account.

What to follow from Pakistan
The KSE-100 as the headline domestic index
USD/PKR, which drives imported inflation and the local value of foreign holdings
Dated PSX constituent and sector information to distinguish index weights from a claim about what caused a move
Global oil prices, given their outsized effect on the Pakistani import bill
Country-specific practice worksheet

Optional study worksheet: assume a fictional dollar-priced oil import and two hypothetical PKR-per-USD rates. Calculate the rupee cost with the dollar oil price fixed, then change the oil price while holding the exchange rate constant. This isolates two arithmetic effects rather than predicting inflation or policy. Compare the assumptions with separately dated official observations and record any differences. The exercise does not establish permission to open or fund a foreign-market account.

Educational simulation only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Confirm all local rules with a licensed professional in Pakistan.

Student perspective

Students and beginners can use the simulator and courses to practise market concepts and document simulated decisions without risking money.

Local brokers & tax
Securities brokers on the SECP's current licensed-broker list — verify current status with the SECP

Tax treatment depends on current law and individual circumstances. Check current official Pakistani guidance or a qualified tax professional; TradeHQ does not provide tax advice.

FAQ for Pakistan learners
Can I use TradeHQ without a Pakistani bank account?
Do you cover PSX-listed shares?
Ready to practise?

Open a free $100,000 practice account instantly — no signup, no card, no geo lock.

Learning notes: Learn Trading in Pakistan

A localised free guide for Pakistan learners — local regulator, local exchange, tax note and the same $100,000 virtual practice account.

Published by TradeHQ, created by Anuga Weerasinghe. Publisher background and editorial approach. No independent professional review is claimed; any recorded source-check scope appears on the page.

Trading from Pakistan

TradeHQ provides a free paper-trading environment for people in Pakistan who want to learn global market mechanics without opening a real-money brokerage account.

Publisher and source-check scope

Published by TradeHQ; site creator: Anuga Weerasinghe. Regulatory source check: 2026-10-18. Linked regulator or registry information; no verification of individual eligibility, tax rates or remittance permission. No professional legal or financial review.

Why practise first

Paper trading lets users practise global-market mechanics without relying on a particular real-money funding or overseas-access route. Current access and exchange-control rules should be checked with official Pakistani sources.

How market access works here

For real-money market access, check the SECP's current licensed-broker and intermediary information together with current provider requirements. For foreign-market access or outward remittances, verify the current rules with the relevant Pakistani authorities and financial institution. Simulated practice on TradeHQ requires no brokerage account or payment.

Regulation

For securities regulation and intermediary information, consult Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP). Registration for one activity does not establish that every product, overseas service or funding route is permitted. Use the official sources below for the applicable rules.

Broker types used locally
Securities brokers on the SECP's current licensed-broker list — verify current status with the SECP
Starting capital and eligibility

TradeHQ does not publish a real-money starting amount because broker requirements, charges and personal circumstances vary. Verify any current minimum or eligibility rule directly with a licensed provider if you ever consider a real account.

Locally relevant assets to follow
The KSE-100 as the headline domestic index
USD/PKR, which drives imported inflation and the local value of foreign holdings
Dated PSX constituent and sector information to distinguish index weights from a claim about what caused a move
Global oil prices, given their outsized effect on the Pakistani import bill
